nodes.title: §1 Purpose — Responsibilities of this crate
nodes.summary: Defines the purpose of siprs crate: providing safe async SIP client via PJSUA FFI with tokio-native API. Audio-only, no video.

nodes.title: §1a M20 Implementation Priority Map
nodes.summary: Lists all M20 supplement items organized by priority (P0-P3) with design decision references and affected code ranges.

nodes.summary: Cross-reference table mapping design decision IDs (Q1:A-Q14:A) to their derivation process and corresponding M20 supplement sections.

nodes.title: §2 Non-goals and Tauri Boundary
nodes.summary: Defines explicit non-goals (SIP server, PBX, GUI, video) and Tauri integration responsibility boundary distinguishing crate vs integrator concerns.

texts: 2.1 Tauri（フロントエンド）統合との責務境界

nodes.title: §3 Glossary
nodes.summary: Defines key domain terms: Client, Account, Call, Media Session, Source, Chunk Pair, Raw SIP Event.

nodes.title: §4 Compliance Requirements and MSRV
nodes.summary: Specifies MSRV (Rust 1.95), tokio as sole async runtime, PJSIP 2.17 pin, target OS triple, and prebuilt-first build strategy.

nodes.title: §4.1 Versioning Policy
nodes.summary: Defines semver policy for 0.x (flexible, breaking changes allowed with CHANGELOG) and 1.0+ (strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

texts: 4.1 バージョニングポリシー

nodes.title: §5 Functional Requirements
nodes.summary: Normative scope listing 15 functional requirements: multi-account, dynamic CRUD, transports, ICE, codecs (PCMU/Opus), DTMF, event bus, audio, resampling, mixing, error handling, Send+Sync.

nodes.title: §6 Module Structure and Crate Layout
nodes.summary: Describes the src/ module tree with lib, client, config, account, call, transport, event, error, audio/, ffi/, runtime/, util/ directories and their responsibilities.

nodes.title: §6.1 Crate Responsibility Split Design Decision
nodes.summary: Design rationale for single-crate approach: PJSIP tight coupling, call-media indivisibility, Tauri integration practicality. Future split possibility to siprs-core + siprs-media.

texts: 6.1 Crate 責務分割方針（設計判断）

nodes.title: §7 Concurrency Model and Execution Contexts
nodes.summary: Describes four execution contexts: User async, Core reactor thread, PJSIP native callbacks, Audio worker tasks. Separates async and sync boundaries.

nodes.title: §7.1 Execution Contexts Detail
nodes.summary: Detailed description of each execution context: user tokio task, core reactor std::thread, PJSIP C callbacks (enqueue only), AudioWorker on blocking pool.

nodes.title: §7.1a Single Reactor Scalability Note
nodes.summary: Design note justifying single-thread reactor for target use cases (~30 concurrent calls). Large-scale PBX scenarios deferred.

texts: 7.1a 単一Reactorのスケーラビリティ注記

nodes.title: §7.2 Command Serialization via RuntimeCommand
nodes.summary: Defines RuntimeCommand enum with all command variants (Initialize, AddAccount, MakeCall, Hangup, etc.) and MPSC-based serialization to single reactor thread.

nodes.title: §8 Public API Design
nodes.summary: Complete public API surface: crate root re-exports, SipClient structure and methods, SipAccountHandle API, OutgoingCallRequest and CallMediaPreferences.

nodes.title: §9 ID Design — Newtype Identifiers
nodes.summary: Defines AccountId, CallId, AudioSourceId as NonZeroU64 newtypes with BiMap to PJSUA native IDs for safe runtime identification.

nodes.title: §10 ClientConfig Complete Specification
nodes.summary: Complete ClientConfig struct definition with all fields including audio config, timeouts, raw SIP event config, and LogLevel enum.

nodes.title: §10.1 Default Configuration Values
nodes.summary: Default values for ClientConfig: user-agent, max_calls, capacity, audio format (16kHz/i16/stereo), timeouts, transport defaults.

nodes.title: §11 AccountConfig Complete Specification
nodes.summary: Complete AccountConfig struct with all sub-configs: AccountCodecPolicy, OpusConfig, DtmfPolicy, AccountMediaConfig.

nodes.title: §11.1 Validation Rules for AccountConfig
nodes.summary: Mandatory validation rules: username/domain/password non-empty, codec policy requirement, DTMF method requirements, registrar auto-derivation.

nodes.title: §12 TransportConfig Complete Specification
nodes.summary: TransportConfig enum with UDP/TCP/TLS variants, TlsConfig, and feature-gated TLS API design.

nodes.title: §13 ICE/STUN/TURN Complete Specification
nodes.summary: IceConfig with defaults (enabled, aggressive nomination), StunServerConfig, TurnServerConfig. Notes on trickle ICE limitation.

nodes.title: §14 Error Design — SipError and SipErrorKind
nodes.summary: Complete error type design: SipError with kind, message, native_status, account_id, call_id, retryable flag. SipErrorKind enum with all variants.

nodes.title: §14.1 Error Conversion Policy
nodes.summary: Rules for converting pj_status_t to SipError, SIP response code mapping, and callback panic handling via InternalInvariantBroken.

nodes.title: §14 M20 New RuntimeCommand Error Design
nodes.summary: Error design for ConfConnect, ConfDisconnect, GetAccountInfo using existing SipErrorKind variants without adding new ones. Rationale for reuse.

nodes.title: §15.2-15.3 SipEvent and EventMeta
nodes.summary: SipEvent wrapper struct with meta+payload. EventMeta: event_id, timestamp, account_id, call_id, direction, headers, status_code, reason_phrase, logical_context.

nodes.title: §15.4 EventBus Implementation
nodes.summary: EventBus struct with dual broadcast channels (control + raw_sip), subscribe/publish methods, and capacity configuration.

nodes.title: §15.5 AccountEventReceiver
nodes.summary: AccountEventReceiver filters broadcast events by account_id. Loop-based recv() that discards non-matching events.

nodes.title: §15.6-15.7 Event Bus Design Decisions
nodes.summary: Design rationale for control/raw_sip split, lossy delivery via broadcast, no retransmission, capacity sizing guidelines, and source-of-truth role of query API.
